title: Dark
premise: Jonas’s father, Michael, has died. Then a boy named Mikkel goes missing. How can the missing child and the dead father be the same person?
ending: Mikkel grows up as Michael Kahnwald, Jonas’s father. Michael’s adult life occurs before Mikkel’s disappearance on the calendar, but after that disappearance in Mikkel’s own experience. This is one strand of Dark, not an explanation of its entire family knot.

people.name: Mikkel Nielsen / Michael Kahnwald
people.introduction: One person: Mikkel is the child; Michael is the name he uses as an adult.

events.title: Mikkel goes missing in 2019
events.text: Mikkel disappears near the Winden caves. For his family, this starts a search for a missing child.

events.title: He finds himself in 1986
events.text: Mikkel emerges in a Winden that is recognisable but decades too early. He cannot simply return to his family’s present.

events.title: The missing child grows up as Michael
events.text: Ines Kahnwald takes care of Mikkel. Over the following years, he grows up using the name Michael Kahnwald.

events.title: Michael becomes Jonas’s father
events.text: As an adult, Michael has a son, Jonas, with Hannah. Jonas therefore grows up knowing Michael as his father, without knowing that his father was once the missing boy Mikkel.

events.title: Michael leaves a letter before he dies
events.text: Michael dies in 2019 before the child Mikkel disappears. His letter explains that he was Mikkel. The date on this card belongs to Michael’s death and the letter he leaves; Jonas learns the truth later, after the disappearance.

chapters.title: Follow the missing child
chapters.introduction: Follow one person’s life from childhood to adulthood. This differs from both calendar order and the order in which Jonas learns the truth.
